Early December, nineteen seventy-five. There is a new member in the room, so Hatonn introduces himself again, and in the introduction he quietly sets the terms for everything that follows. His people, he says, have gone beyond the need for extreme self-identification. The members of the Confederation have reached a unification of consciousness and desire. Their purpose is the same as their desire, and their desire is to share their love and knowledge with whoever requests it. They claim not to be beings of a supreme nature. They are not infallible. They only feel they have a greater understanding, and they offer it to those who want it. Nobody is forced. That is the standing offer.

Then comes the central teaching of the night. For in service to another, he says, inevitably you are serving yourself. The universe and all that is in it are one being, and no more, with each being and each particle within it being one particle within a whole, all united within consciousness and spirit. And through this unification comes the undeniable fact that service to one is service to all, and to oneself. Accept separations within your consciousness, he says, and they shall exist temporarily for you. But deny them, and the ones you have accepted for so long shall begin to fade from your awareness. And you shall begin to know the truth. There are no separations.

We of the Confederation, he says, are beings as yourself, with no greater capabilities than what you possess. The only difference is that we, mostly through the use of meditation, have broadened our awareness beyond what you have done. In our domain, there is not that which you consider to be negative. All that there is is love and light, love being the physical manifestation of all things. Each time that you express your love, you have created. And each time you pass up a chance to show love, you have passed up your chance to develop your birthright of being a creator.

He knows this next part sounds absurd to the everyday mind, and he says so. To say you are the Creator, that the Creator cannot get along without you, that you are gods, seems laughable, even egocentric, at the level where these words unfortunately land. But he asks the listeners to loosen their thinking. You are very close to yourself, he says, and very far from the nearest star, so you seem much larger than the star. It is a matter of perspective. In reality the star is majestic and enormous compared to you. And if you are one with the star, then the star is one with you, and neither complete without the other. It is no more than what your holy works already say, where sparrows, which are two for a penny, never fall without the Creator knowing.

We do not know what the Creator is, he says. We do not know His nature, His actions, His purposes. The Creator is infinite, invisible. This we know, for this He has shown us again and again. That He created us in a vibration of pure love, and that He considers all of us as Himself. We come to give you a message of love. We come to tell you that you are gods, not because you are so wonderful, but because the Creator is wonderful.

And then the passage the whole evening was building toward. The Creator is within you. Stand away from your personality, he says, and see if you can find that faraway sun within you, that star shining in the darkness and depths of your soul. There shines the Creator. In some cases terribly distant, yet always there, and always shining. All you need do is look up. Within yourself, begin to seek for that star.

It may seem, he admits, that your human personality may never get the hang of showing the Creator's love to others, that your situations are too limited for showing love. But the place whereon you are standing is holy ground. You do not need to put yourself into a situation which seems outwardly spiritual in order to be in a spiritual situation. The universe is a spiritual universe. When the situation seems difficult, wait for a moment for the realization to come to you that in you is a spirit, and within that spirit is enough love to carry you through.

And he closes with the line that stays. In the creation, he says, there can be no sorrow. Keep meditating. And never give up hope. For you are part of the Creator. This you will realize more each day. And it is true.

Thank you for listening.

title: Born in the Dark
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: born in the dark.

December twenty-first, nineteen seventy-five. The longest night of the year, and the group is sitting together in the cold of it. Hatonn takes that cold as his starting point. He talks about the story their culture tells at this season, the story of a child born in the darkest winter, poor, cold, hungry, the child that grew to be the master known as Jesus. And then he says the sentence that turns the whole evening. Each of you, he says, is waiting to be born. Each of you is in the dark, in the cold. For it is within the darkness and the chill that all things come together to be born. It is the nurturing, saving darkness. And the chill is necessary.

With meditation, he says, you nurture and comfort that soul within you as it struggles toward its spiritual birth. There has been much misunderstanding about why the mother of Jesus is called a virgin. It is to indicate, he says, that the spirit is not of man but of the Father. Each of you is of the Father. Each of you is waiting to be born. Nurture that within yourself. No matter that the environment may seem less than perfect. It surely cannot be more imperfect than a cold, cold stable, and a stall, and animals for companions.

He had opened the evening with a warning about the intellect. The words they speak through the channel are offered, he says, as intellectual guidance along the pathway of enlightenment. Yet the intellect is only a minor tool in your development. Your intellectual capacities are quite limited. There are many things you have accepted as truth that are unexplainable through the intellectual process. Uncomprehendable, yet true. Truth is infinite. And all things within the creation are unlimited, as is your experience, and as is your knowledge. For your knowledge truly lies within the core of your being, within the oneness of the Creator, within His presence within you.

Man upon planet Earth, he says, presently stands upon the threshold of unlimited knowledge, unlimited love. It is your birthright to know these truths. Yet there is only one way to truly comprehend them. And that way is through the practice of meditation. Allow the intellect to still itself. Allow it to rest. And let the spiritual intellect begin to avail its information to you. You may not hear words, but you shall hear truth and love. In your moments of silence, you shall hear the universe speaking through the lips of the Creator the truths of infinity and love.

And then, after the talk of darkness and birth, he gives the image that holds it all. Love moves in the darkness, he says, and its energy brings forth the light. Each of you is formed in perfect love. Each of you shines with perfect light. But there are many, many colors. How many colors can you think of? Perhaps the number is infinite, for there are shades and gradations within each color that go on and on. And each one is distinguishable from the next. And yet in reality, each is a part of the white light. So are you. And all that you meet are other portions of the same light, formed in perfect love also.

How hard it is, he admits, to see the perfection of the Father in each person. Each person is a different shade, and some shades seem to clash with yours. But all are formed of white light. All are one with you, and you with them.

Why are you here? He asks it plainly, the way a friend might. We may say, to find out why you are here. For the Creator Itself knows Itself, and the desire that caused you is a desire to realize selfhood. The Creator is waiting to be known as the Father. He waits within you, and can be found through meditation.

The evening ends with the old law, stated plainly. What we give determines, immediately and completely, what we get. We cannot receive further knowledge unless we give freely of what we have now. We are with you, he says. At the moment that you desire it, we are with you. We can only help you if you desire it. That is our way. We leave the free will of each person in creation alone.

And the last word is for the dark you may be sitting in. Surround yourself in this love, he says. To all that you come in contact with. There is nothing stronger than love. It is an existence we have experienced for some time, and the happiness we experience cannot even be imagined by you. This is, as we said, your birthright.

Thank you for listening.

title: The Shepherd's Compassion
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: the shepherd's compassion.

Later that same December night in nineteen seventy-five, Hatonn speaks a second time, to the smaller group that stayed. And he speaks to them of shepherds. You may look upon your little world, he says, as being made up of those who need care, and those who may do the caring. But his question is not about the sheep. It is about the shepherd. What will inspire you to the compassion of the shepherd with his sheep? Where does the compassion come from?

His answer is not what you expect. He asks them to remember that the universe is not deadly serious, but rather is a universe of love and joy, of lightness and laughter. It is not necessary that you be so deadly serious that you insist upon absolute compassion within yourself. It is enough, he says, if you accept a certain lighthearted desire to pretend, shall we say, to be somewhat similar to a compassionate shepherd. You are not attempting to fool the sheep into thinking you are compassionate. You are attempting to fool yourself, from a condition of illusion to a condition of reality.

You cannot bludgeon yourselves into this state, he says. Yet you must shepherd yourself, gently and coaxingly and with humor. Act similarly to that which you would consider to be compassionate, and slowly you will discover that you are not acting. Allow yourself that imperfection of ambition which is within the illusion. For you are learning.

What differentiates you from the sheep, then, who are also learning? There is a broad line that cannot be crossed by sheep, he says, and that line is the desire to know. Sheep will be led, and if they are lost, they must be found. But the shepherds have the desire to know, in order that they may serve. This desire of yours, to know the Creator and to serve Him, this desire is all that you need to be upon the path of the shepherd. Follow it in joy and humor, for being deadly serious will cause you to stumble.

And then, in the spirit of the season, he turns to the teacher of the season. Jesus, he says, was a being who resided upon the planet Earth for the purpose of demonstrating a proper way of living, a proper way of loving. And here he corrects a doctrine plainly. This great teacher did not die for you. He demonstrated for you that there was in all actuality no death. For no matter how much they were able to torture him and maim his body, he was able to overcome his oppressors with love. And with that same love he demonstrated the great power contained within it. The power over life and death. The power over nature.

You may have been taught that his death was necessitated to relieve you of your bondage and sins. In a concept such as this, there is also truth, he says, for is not the realization of the power of love redemption? The answer is love. The realization of love is indeed your redemption. The physical death was not your redemption, for all beings have experienced this. But the awakening to the abilities and the power within the concept of love, indeed, was your salvation.

Love was the ingredient that made those accomplishments possible. Not the being himself in physical form, but the love within the being. That love is also within you. It is within all things. Accept this. Love is all. Love is omnipotent. Love is Jesus, and love is you. And all together, all of these loves combined, all of these beings combined, are the Creator.

I love how he closes it, because he refuses to let anyone turn this into a throne. Do not look upon yourself as an omnipotent ruler or teacher, he says. Look upon all, all of the beings you have known or shall ever know, as being these teachers and rulers and overseers of the creation and its inhabitants. Everyone you meet is wearing the same secret.

So the shepherd's compassion is not a heavy office. It is a lighthearted pretense that becomes real. Gently, with humor, act as the compassionate one would act, until one day you notice you are no longer acting. And the desire that got you there was never complicated. Only the desire to know, in order to serve.

Thank you for listening.

title: Pride and Humility
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: pride and humility.

December twenty-eighth, nineteen seventy-five. The Christmas season is ending, and Hatonn borrows the words of the teacher of that season to open. It is written, he says, in the words of your most recent master, the one known as Jesus. Not as the world gives, give I unto you. And as I offer you my peace, may I say, this is so.

He speaks first of love, and of where to look for it. You are not seeking a substitute reality in place of the present one, he says. You are seeking to know your own reality for the first time. You are even now, at this moment, dwelling in reality. It is truly written. Heaven is all about you. You are not seeking a faraway, long-distant kingdom. For the kingdom of Heaven is with you, within you, and about you.

If you do these things to the least of these, my brethren, you do them unto me. The Creator is within the face that is across from you, on the street, and in your house. Each stranger, each friend, and each enemy is the Creator. He asks them to look at each other, and for the first time, truly see the very best within each other. Within the one known as Jesus was a sight which was of love. Those about him could be described in rather unfavorable terms. Harlots, tax-collectors, publicans, beggars, the sick and the crippled. And in no case did he see them as anything but the Father, directly before him on the physical plane. He looked with love. To the sinner he said, this day, you will be with me in paradise.

Then comes the passage I think of as the hinge of the evening. There are two dangers in seeking, he says, and he says it with a sense of humor, for the dangers are not real. It is the balancing between them that causes your progress. These two dangers are pride and humility.

Woe be unto the man who begins to feel that it is his love that is setting those about him on the path of light, that it is his compassion that is such a light to others. Woe be unto this man, for the love of the personality is limited. It will run out, and in its wake will come much sadness.

Woe also to the person who says, I am unworthy. In my humility I must admit I cannot be a fit channel for the love of the Creator. Do not expect me to keep trying the impossible, for I am not worthy, and I cannot do this.

In neither case, he says, have you quite hit the balance. Balance between confidence and the knowledge of your own imperfections as a personality. You see, both of these things are true, and neither of them matter. You are a channel through which the Creator may express Himself. The Creator is love, and His expression is love.

He gives them an image for it. To your outer eye, a person may be nothing but a very common-looking or even unpleasant piece of stone. A large rock, awkward and peculiarly colored. Yet to the eye within, the eye of love, this rock will be the shape which the master may carve from the rock, so that it becomes a beautiful statue, with all the potential of that piece of rock set free in beauty of line. People are both their raw materials and the possibility of perfection. It is the Creator Who causes these possibilities to become manifest.

You cannot do it. Of course not. You can only say to the Creator, please, live this moment for me. Allow my eyes to shine with your light. Picture your eyes as windows, he says, and make sure the shades are up, so that the light may shine through. The shades are made of prejudice, judgment, petty feelings and negativity of all kinds. Again and again you will find yourself pulling the shades down. Always it is the precise moment of now that is important. If you have been in error, simply choose at this moment to release that error, and let the shades up, and let the light shine through. What has happened in the past is completely done with.

He closes the night with the journey itself. Before time began, he says, you chose to embark upon a journey, and its destination is the point from which the journey began. It is a circle which you travel, a circle of infinity, of infinite experience. And between the beginning and the end there shall be no passing of time. For in all reality, there exist no variants such as you know as time. In due time, he says, you shall realize that each of us has already begun and completed his journey. We have gone nowhere. We have done nothing. Yet we have gone to all places, and we have done all things.

Do not become concerned with your progression, he says. Your spiritual progression is as natural to your being as breathing is to your body. Leave yourself open. Remain receptive for the love of the Creator. Nothing else within this universe is worthy of desire. Desire only love, for it is all things.

Thank you for listening.

title: The Eternal New Year
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: the eternal new year.

January fourth, nineteen seventy-six. The first meditation of the new year, and Hatonn meets the occasion with a teaching on cycles. Both illusion and reality, he says, are made up of cycles, so that the cycle of your world is rooted in meaning. The ingredients of this cycle are love and light. At what is known as the New Year, the future is just coming to be and the past is dead. And at this time, even within the illusion, you can see that this is so. It does not matter how deep into the illusion you go. The pathway always follows directly back to the Creator.

Treasure the lesson of this New Year, he says. And know that, eternally and for each moment, your past shall be dead, your future shall lie aborning before you. There is, eternally, both the night that has passed and the day that is to come. The sunset and the sunrise. This is not only a calendar truth. It is the structure of your whole existence.

The secret within the illusion is reality, he says. The entire challenge of your life is to comprehend the reality which the illusion is wrapped around. As you act out your part within the illusion, you are acting out a path which leads directly to the truth. It is not separate from your life, but at the very core. Meditate, he asks, so that you may remain in contact with the reality that lies at the center of this illusion which you call physical life.

It is so easy not to pay attention. It does not seem that the cycle will end, and that death as you know it will succeed life as you know it. It does not seem that you will be called to account, not for the illusion but for that mysterious center of reality you have been nurturing all your physical life. Yet this is so. There will come a day when the old year of your physical life will expire, and the New Year of your life within spirit will succeed it. And upon that day, the past shall be dead, and the future will be aborning.

So what is to be done, in the meantime? At each moment, he says, allow your energy to penetrate to the center of your world, so that you live not only the drama of illusion but the reality at the center. And what is this reality? Love. Love within all, and all within love. The least of these, my brethren, is the same as I, said the master known as Jesus. Reality for you lies within each meeting. Even the least of those has been born in love, and if you can realize this love within him, you have given him the reality within his center. Such service as this is what links you to your center. It is what keeps you within reality.

Your consciousness of love, he says, will continue forever. Your consciousness of love will be your spiritual personality for eternity. Within this consciousness, the cycles of life and death are merely periods which seem as meaningless as the ticking noise of a clock seems in a year. Within the consciousness of the physical illusion, life and death are weighty and serious matters, shocking even to discuss. Within the consciousness of love, all is one and there is nothing to fear. And no one to resist. All that you see is love.

Later in the evening, he speaks to one listener about the intellect. The intellect, he says, can be a useful tool in dealing with this illusion. Yet it is a destructive and damaging tool when used to work with emotions or spirit. That which is to come alive within you is of the spirit. There is no deadness within your spirit. There is no limit to your soul. Trust your deeper soul. Trust your spirit. And do not attempt to contain it within intellectual rigidity.

And he leaves them with an image for the meditation cushion. Within the darkness of the universe lies a tiny spark. And if you look at it steadily, it grows, and grows, and becomes a flaming sphere, and finally it totally engulfs you. So in meditation, know the infinity behind your closed eyes. Find that spark of pure love, and then let it expand until it has totality.

Every year ends. Every moment ends. And eternally, the future lies aborning before you. That is not a consolation. That is the mechanics of the whole thing.

Thank you for listening.

title: The Gift of Suffering
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: the gift of suffering.

January eleventh, nineteen seventy-six. The group has gathered for the first of two meditations that night, and Hatonn speaks to a listener who is suffering, and through her, to everyone who has ever wondered why pain is allowed to be so real. The very word suffering, he says, shows how real the illusion is to you. And indeed, this is as it should be. If the illusion were not real, you would not learn from it. It would not be an effective catalyst and you would not progress sufficiently under its stimulus.

That which seems to be suffering, he says, is precisely as valuable as a lesson problem is in school. You learn the lesson in order that you may pass the test. There are easy tests, and there are hard tests. If one is able to pass a harder test, one advances more quickly, perhaps to the next grade, instead of to the next semester within the same grade. There are many upon your planet at this time who have elected to utilize this physical experience to obtain the greatest possible lesson, to take the greatest possible test, and to advance the greatest possible amount. These people have chosen their tests. They chose to advance rapidly, within a path that is totally made of love.

Within the illusion, it may seem that there is suffering. This suffering is a valuable gift. It is burning away the dross, that the gold may appear. I love that old image, the furnace and the gold, and he means it the way the old alchemists meant it. Nothing is wasted in the fire.

Penetrate to the center of this illusion which you call suffering, he says, and know that in love a perfect being is seeking its path. Each entity will suffer. Each entity will proceed on its path. For each entity there will be dark nights, and then, the dawn. Do not admire those who seem not to suffer, for it is truly written that the last shall be first, and the first, last.

Do not dwell within the illusion, he says. The intellect cannot deal with the reality within it. Seek only to know the Creator. And then he asks the question that the whole evening turns on. Do you not know, my sister, that all is love?

He goes on to speak of something the group rarely hears named so plainly. The solitude of the soul. For each soul, he says, there is a great solitude. One soul is on one path. And no one or no thing can keep that soul company on that path. For each entity is the Creator, is primary, and must teach itself what it already knows. Sometimes, in this loneliness, we have bad dreams. He does not mean literal dreams. He means the times when a shadow seems to be over our lives. And he admits something startling. We are not free of these upon the plane from which I speak. Yes, we have advanced, yet we do not know all. We are alone in our way, as we speak of unity, yet we have loneliness when we are not able to totally live this understanding. These moments grow fewer and fewer as you continue to seek.

It is a matter, he says, of being in reality instead of the illusion. When the shadow falls across you, know it for an illusion. If you must speak aloud to remind yourself, you may say, all is love. And you will feel reality flow within you at that moment.

Within the illusion, he says, there is good and evil, what you call Christ, and what you call anti-Christ. Yet within the Creator, all is one. When there is seemingly a negativity, do not attempt to outwardly discern it, or intellectually discover its negativity or positivity. Rather, immediately go within, until you find the Creator. Within the Creator, all is one, and there is no knowledge of separation of any sort that can possibly harm you. Nor can you harm anyone. No harm can come to you. No harm can go from you. Unity. Unity. All is love. Throughout all eternity, your spirit is safe and secure, for these things are without meaning within unity.

Your brothers and sisters are with you, he says. And the gift, hard as it is to hold, is this. The fire you are walking through was chosen by the part of you that wanted the gold.

Thank you for listening.

title: The Truth Within
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: the truth within.

January eleventh, nineteen seventy-six, the second meditation. Hatonn opens with the simplest statement in the archive, and the one most easily misunderstood. All of the people upon your planet are searching for the answer to their existence. All are anxious to know the truth. The truth is pure and simple. You are the truth, and within you it lies.

When we say the truth lies within you, he goes on, we say that which is most easily misunderstood. When the master known as Jesus said, thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself, this too is most often misunderstood. It has been understood to mean that we must love each other's good points and bad points, our failures as well as our successes. That the truth lies within the illusion. We do not wish to indicate, he says, that the truth within you has a thing to do with your outer covering of deeds and actions. Nor did the master mean that you must love the outer wrappings of others.

What we are suggesting, and what the master was suggesting, is that you penetrate the illusion, penetrate the wrapping of deeds and misdeeds, and discover within that illusion the reality of the Creator, the reality of love. Within you lies the truth. Within you lies love. Within each fellow man lies the same truth.

To love another, as we mean it, he says, is to love that within them which is one with that which is within you. To love yourself is not to love the outer wrapping of personality, but to honor and hallow that divinity that you are, which is at your very center. It is not possible to love your neighbor or yourself from a human level. The human love will fail. There is a higher law, my friends, the law of love. Not the human love. That will fail. But the love which you will find at the center of your created being.

My friends, you cannot try to love. Only let go of your feelings, and release them completely into the care of the love that created you. It is not expected that, at the human level, you will be able to love as the Creator desires. It is only as those who open to the center of their being that the love within flows through the physical being, and out into the physical illusion. You may release this from within you just as a person may, on a very dark night, raise all the window shades in his house, so that the light within may pour out onto the world around him. The light within you shines brightly. Whether you know it or not, whether you feel it or not, you have such power within you, such beauty of soul, such love, that it is indescribable.

Later, a listener asks about the suffering of someone she loves, her mother, and whether there is a reason for it. Hatonn's answer is tender and strange. Your suffering, he says, is not of a physical nature. It is one of spirit. Caring not of your emotions, it is expressing love for the one whom you love. What appears to you upon this plane to be the suffering of a loved one is only a projection of your existence and your love. Though it appears to be suffering, it is only an infinite expression of love within this infinite creation, which to the intellect is incomprehensible. The more you suffer, he says, the more you allow your emotions to believe it is suffering. The longer you deny the lesson, you do not suffer. Your spirit is expressing love.

Another asks whether meditation dissolves karma. No, he says, and then gives the image. There is a law within this density, visible as cause and effect. Nothing happens that has not been caused. That is karma, and the law does not become abrogated. There is a higher law, the Law of Love. If you invoke this law, it will dissolve the karma. Yet you invoke it through action. It is as though there were a fire raging out of control, and you stood by it meditating, and it came to you that you would overcome fire with water. And there you sit in meditation, with a pail of water in your hand. But you have not put the water on the fire. Go from the meditation with the understanding, and put out that fire. Do it consciously, and know that the law of love is overcoming the law of karma.

So the truth within is not a place to hide. It is a place to fill the pail, and then to stand up, and to act.

Thank you for listening.

title: Love Is Sacrifice
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: love is sacrifice.

January eighteenth, nineteen seventy-six. Hatonn begins the evening by pulling back a curtain most listeners never think to ask about. He explains what happens during channeling itself, the electromagnetic vibration, the conditioning wave, the different reactions in different bodies. It is a cut-and-dried, limited, intellectual wave, he says, useful and given in love, but limited all the same. And then he names what it is not.

There is another vibration, he says, which is far more desirable, and not at all the same as the channeling wave. The basic vibration of the Creator, perfect love, is a vibration given not only through us, but through your aides and guides, whom you would call angels, through your own inner self, through teachers upon your own spiritual planes, everywhere, everywhere within the creation. This original Vibration of love is reality. In meditation you are seeking not an electromagnetic wave from us. You are seeking perfect love.

What the channel gives you in words, he says, is only a poor physical food for your physical mind. Spiritual food lies in silence, in contemplation, in what you would call prayer. In listening to the original Thought of creation, the original Vibration that, out of nothingness, created all that there is. Listen now to the silence again. And listen beyond words.

Then he turns to the question of love and sacrifice. Have you pierced the veil of this truth of love? It is written that the master known as Jesus said, in order to love Him, we must pick up a cross. My brothers, this is truth. Love is sacrifice. There is a further and transforming truth that can only be learned once the leap has been made into love, once the sacrifice has been freely given, not grudgingly, but freely. That which you give is given to yourself. Truer words never were.

As you love, so you will be loved. What you are, what your reality is, is totally a result of your thought. To sacrifice to another is your only way of giving. That which does not cost you anything is not a true gift. To give, it must be infinite. It must be all. It may not be physically of any moment or importance. Yet within yourself, to be a gift it must be at some cost to yourself, and freely given. Then you have considered your brother as the master and yourself as the servant. And you are interested in serving your brother. And then, you have found the secret of love. For all of the creation was designed to be of service to each other part of the creation.

That which you give enriches you beyond measure, he says, and that which you hold back will strangle you. How often people think that they are poor, when in fact they simply have not given enough away. How often have you been lonely, when you could reach out and aid another's loneliness? Do you not know that to sacrifice is to love, and to love others is only to love yourself?

This is not an easy lesson. We know that, he says. Go back into the silence when you have difficulties, and you will have difficulties. As often as you can, regularly, find love within you. And then, give it away. For you are truly rich, my brothers.

A newer channel speaks briefly that night, and his message fits the evening like a key in a lock. During our days, he says, much of our time is spent in needless worry over things that really do not matter. And the things in our lives that really do matter, such as meditation and seeking the truth, are always left for another day, or put off until tomorrow, when in truth these are the most important things in your whole life. This is the reason you were put here on this planet, to search and seek and try to find a way back to the infinite Creator.

And Hatonn's final word on the night is a quiet one. Perfect love is within your reach, he says. It is not a dream upon which you focus at certain times, and then cast away as something far in the future, or something unattainable. It is real. It completely engulfs you at all times. If you are truly seeking on the spiritual path, if you desire the higher thoughts and vibrations, then expect to attain these things. You must believe that it can happen before it will happen.

The price of love is sacrifice. The reward is that what you give is given to yourself. The accounts balance in a way the world cannot see.

Thank you for listening.

title: The Garden Within
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: the garden within.

January twenty-fifth, nineteen seventy-six. Hatonn opens with three words that fill the whole room. I am Hatonn. I greet you, my friends, in the love and the light of the infinite Creator. I am He who is among you. I am He who is within you. I AM. Dwell now within the I AM that you are, he says. For I AM, not only now but always. Before this world was created and when it is long since passed again into infinite space, I AM.

The creation began, he says, with consciousness, the consciousness of one vibration, each and every particle totally unified, totally homogeneous, of only one identity, that identity being love. We use the word love because of the bias it contains within your language. The word consciousness is slightly more accurate, yet this consciousness is the consciousness which creates. Therefore we must use the word love. The creation began in an infinite and constant state of love, vibrating infinitely and in unity. And this creation sent forth the power of love to differentiate into entities that could dwell in self-knowledge, in unity, yet in knowledge of unity.

This, he says, is described in your Garden of Eden, and in all worlds and universes there are descriptions which describe the state of self-awareness of unity. And then there arose a knowledge of separation. In choosing that path, the dimensions were born. For these entities had chosen a path which, in separation, cannot express the unity of all with all. The vibrations of separation traveled downward through many frequencies, and consciousness formed a great array of potential experiences on many levels. One of which you are now experiencing.

You are experiencing separation. That is the meaning of your physical being. With your senses, you can only feel that which is within yourself. This incarnation, he says, is an incarnation of loneliness and pain, for separation is such.

Why have you come here? Why now do you vibrate in sympathy with loneliness and separation? Why now must you accept pain? So all entities will choose to do, he says, while they are learning to seek the healing from that pain.

And here he gives them distance on their problems, as he puts it, not to diminish them, but to set them in their true frame. You were not invested with a physical form in order to ignore what is happening to you in the physical. Yet know that these things are occurring to you in such a way that you will not be tested beyond your ability, for you have yourself chosen these lessons. You have yourself chosen this pain. And you hope very dearly, in your higher self, to learn from this pain the lessons you have come here to learn.

It is a hard thing, he admits, to ask yourself to trust your own judgment when you cannot face your higher self and say, look, I think this is more than I can take. You do not have that satisfaction. You must trust that the self that placed you in the situation you are now in knew and understood your capabilities and, though ambitious of learning as much as possible, did not plan things so as to test you beyond your limit. The more lessons you learn in this incarnation, the more progress you will make. It is not to rejoice at pain, but to understand that within pain there is the peace, when you are convinced within yourself that you have tried as much as possible to learn the lesson that is buried within the experience.

Seek the Father within, he says, and in your fellow men, seek to do service. In the inner worlds, seek to know the Father, and in the outer world, seek to do service to the Father Who is all around you. It is written, one must love one's Creator and one's fellow man as oneself. We say to you, it is not necessary to love one's fellow man on the level of the human. See the Creator, and love the Creator, in him and in you, for that is the same.

He borrows a cliche from the channel's mind and improves it. Every cloud has a silver lining, they say. And we would add that sometimes a fruit may seem inedible, for the skin may be tough and pitted. Yet when you peel it, the fruit within is still succulent and tasty and delicious. Experiences are like this, even the most inconvenient. Be of good cheer, and remember to seek not only the Creator in meditation, but the Creator within your fellow man.

With the armor of your inner guidance, and your light before you on the path, he says, there is nothing that can harm you. Be of good cheer. There is no pain within the garden. And the garden is within you.

That is the whole evening in one breath. The loneliness is real, the pain was chosen, and the garden you are exiled from was never anywhere but inside you.

Thank you for listening.

title: The Armor of Light
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: the armor of light.

February first, nineteen seventy-six. There are new faces in the room, and Hatonn greets them with an image of the whole creation as a ladder. The infinite creation has infinite densities, infinite progressions, he says. And in each progression there is a brotherhood of those upon the same path. As one reaches one higher rung, one of the privileges of learning is responsibility for those below. For we can no longer ascend higher unless we are endeavoring to the utmost to bring those just below us with us. You see, it is the nature of all things within the creation to be of service to the other portions of the creation.

Look at your planet, he says. Your natural growths give forth oxygen that your animals and yourselves breathe, while you give off that which is helpful to the plants. The air itself is a perfect blend so that you might flourish. All dwells in harmony, in an attempt to be of service to that which is around it. The universe is one thing, one complete whole, and all that is in it functions in mutual service to all the other parts.

Then he comes to the teaching the night is really about. Light, my brothers. Imagine yourselves armed, completely covered with an armor of light. The light is so bright and so white, you are so radiant, that no one can look directly at you. You shine like the sun. It is not possible for any harm to penetrate that armor of light, nor is it possible for any harm to leave your mind, your heart, or your hand through this aura of light. You are protected from within and from without.

I love the way he makes it practical, because he names the exact moment we lose it. There are many times, he says, when in your fear you attempt to use your armies, those little armies of soldiers which you call words, and you send your words and your mean actions and your petty emotions out like little soldiers to combat those little enemies, those people about you who seem to be sending their soldiers against you. You feel that you are vulnerable to them, and so you fight back with your little army of words. And you become disturbed and excited. You are not yourself, in the sense that you are no longer a light-being, but a small, dark animal fighting for its position. You have lost the grandeur and the majesty of that within you which is pure light and pure love, and you are reacting as a weak person.

My friends, you need no armies, you need no intellect. You need no fights, for you are completely protected by light.

As he speaks, the wind is roaring against the windows of the house, and he uses it. You are aware of that great disturbance in your outer environment, he says, and we use this to tell you these storms within your emotions may seem just as difficult, just as dark, and just as terrifying. If you felt the need to defend yourself against someone who did not seem to understand, you were not seeing this person as a light being, to whom you should give love only. You were seeing him as someone to be convinced, his army against your army, words against words. Love and light need no words, but only a simple radiation, a radiation from within of the love and the protection from all that may be without of your armor of light.

Never, ever, sell yourselves short, he says. Never let yourselves become in need of that army, if you can possibly remember who you are and what protection you do have. You may play, instead of from weakness, from a position of great strength. The love lies within you, the light shines through you, and there will be nothing which love cannot conquer.

Later, through another channel, he describes what this light is. It is not light as your intellect perceives it. It is the physical manifestation of the love of your Creator. All things visible to your eyes are comprised of units of light. Through a prism a white light may enter and is dispersed as many colors. Therefore all colors, all physical manifestation, have been derived from the pure and infinite glowing white light, which is the physical representative of the love of our Creator.

And Oxal, speaking that same night, adds the other side of the teaching. Within your density there is a natural swing toward progression, and those who close themselves off and think only of themselves come into confrontation with reality. Remember, he says, your self is, in total essence, in total harmony with all that there is. To close yourself off from it is to come into inevitable and destructive confrontation with reality. Please get off of that fifty percent fence that you are now on. Pull yourself onto the side of harmony. Even if your actions are not perfect, if you simply desire to be better, your vibrations will have been pulled off that fence.

The armor is not for fighting. It is for remembering, in the middle of the storm, that you never needed the little armies at all.

Thank you for listening.

title: The Standpoint of the Sun
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: the standpoint of the sun.

February first, nineteen seventy-six, the second meditation. This time the speaker is not named. The transcript only says Unknown. And whoever it was, they gave the group one of the strangest and most beautiful images in the whole archive. I want to stay with it, because it does more work than a whole library of explanations.

You are upon a round ball, he says. Not totally round, but round enough. Consider yourself standing on the surface of the ball. One side of this ball is in light, and the other is in darkness. And it may seem to you very real that you are in darkness now, and that you have been in light earlier today, and that tomorrow the light will come again. For you are upon the surface of a ball, and what is real to you is what is real for that ball. And sometimes there is light, and sometimes there is darkness.

Problems, difficulties, pain, lack, limitation, he says, these things are just like the ball you are standing on. Only you hold these balls. Consider them as evanescent bubbles. When you turn them in your hand, they rotate half in light and half in darkness, and as you see the dark side of the trouble, you experience the lack and the limitation, and the trouble seems very real to you. But lo, the trouble turns in your hand, and the solution is come upon you, and it also seems real to you. And the bubble bursts, and is no more, and in your hand is another bubble, and it is turning its dark side to you.

Your difficulty, he says, is a problem of thinking of yourself as a person standing upon a ball, and holding a ball, both balls being subject to light and darkness. Consider your difficulty from the standpoint of the eternal light and oneness of the sun, and the bubble will burst. There is that within him which is kin to all that there is. He is not a prisoner of light and darkness, for within him is the sun. Within him, even within the intellect of this man, in imagination, there is the ability to go to the point of view of the sun. And from the standpoint of the sun there is no night, and the turning of a ball in infinite space has no meaning, for there is eternal, infinite, unbelievably wasteful light. There is no darkness, from the standpoint of the sun.

For a period of five minutes or so, take one of the works which personally has spiritual meaning for you. Read words of inspiration, until the inspiration gives you the desire to pause and contemplate what you have read. At some point, as you do this daily, you will find that you have stopped thinking about that inspirational thought, and you have not yet thought of anything else. If that pause lasts five seconds, within that five seconds you have made contact with the silence within, and within that silence is the sun. Within that silence is the Creator. Five seconds with the Creator, he says, is ample.

Do not be disheartened if meditations remain short for some time. It is not how long your meditations last, but how earnestly you are seeking. If you knock at that door, it shall be opened.

Another asks whether meditation gets rid of karma, and the answer comes with an image I have never forgotten. There is a law within this density, visible as cause and effect. Nothing happens that has not been caused. That is karma, and the law is not abrogated. There is a higher law, the Law of Love. If you invoke this law, it will dissolve the karma. Yet you invoke it through action. It is as though there were a fire raging out of control, and you stood by it meditating, and it came to you that you would overcome fire with water. And there you sit in meditation, with a pail of water in your hand. But you have not put the water on the fire. Go from the meditation with the understanding, and put out that fire.

And he leaves them with the islands. As we sit here, he says, we are like islands in a stream. You seem like islands, separate, and the waters are rushing past you. Yet you are fixed, still, and you see only that which touches you. My friends, you are the water. One drop of water, that is one with all of the water that reaches from one corner of the world to the other, that touches all that there is, that knows all that all the other drops of water know. Release yourself from that island, in meditation, and become one with the water. Water does not seem strong, yet it is water, gentle, flowing, unified water, that dissolves the rock.

From the standpoint of the sun, there is no night. The trouble is a bubble in your hand. And you are the water, not the island.

Thank you for listening.

title: The River Jordan
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: the river jordan.

February fifteenth, nineteen seventy-six. Hatonn opens with a definition of love that clears the ground. Love is not the emotion that is felt for another. Love is not attachment to any given thing. Love is totally detached, yet infinitely united within truth, within the light of the Creator. All things are united due to the existence of love.

You are here, he says, primarily to learn and understand the concept of love. Your daily experiences are your lessons, and your daily reactions to those experiences shall bear upon your final judgment of your experience. With the proper outlook, these experiences can always be found within the realms of the concept of love.

Then, through another channel, he tells a story. He borrows it from the Bible, and it is worth hearing whole. A leper came from a far country to a prophet, and said, heal me. And the prophet said, do you think that I am a God, that I could heal you? Nay, only go wash in the river of Jordan seven times. And his servant said to him, master, he asked you to do something that was very easy. Would you not have obeyed him if he had asked you to do something difficult? The leper said, why, yes I would have, for I wish to be healed. The servant said, then, master, go wash in the Jordan seven times, for it is very simple, and you want to be healed. And the leper did so, and he became whole.

This experience you are now going through is much like that story, Hatonn says. You are at this point in some manner or other sick, lonesome, unhappy, in some pain or some sadness of physical existence. And you desire to be healed. You desire to be a whole person. We are not prophets. We do not wish to behave as prophets. Yet we say to you, your prophet is love. Your higher self has arranged the basic elements of your life experience, so that your life itself may tell you where the Jordan is, that you may wash and be whole. You need not search for a difficult way to find love. Love is close to you now, at this very moment.

When you have your next painful experience, he says, ask your own experience, your own life, your own situation, where can I be healed? Where is love in this situation? If you are quiet and if you meditate, truth will come to you. The water will become evident. And that portion of your consciousness will be made whole by your understanding of love.

Know, he says, that we are all one. In pain or in pleasure, healing is in knowing that the Creator lies in every breath of air that you breathe, in every plant that gives you pleasure, in every bite of food that gives you health, in all of the friends and all of the enemies. You are looking at the Creator. All is one.

And there is a practical instruction hidden in this. You must have the consciousness of love before you enter the situation. Then, you will receive from that situation love. Without the consciousness of love, you receive what you send out, be that whatever it may. It is written many times in your holy works, as ye sow, so shall ye reap. So, love to the very best of your ability, and you will reap it a hundredfold.

Many of you have wondered, he says, how can I be of service? I do not have a great deal of money. I do not have very special talents. I do not know what to do to be of service. We say to you, meditate and find love. And then open yourself to your own self. Within your life experience there is guidance. The guidance will show you who and how to serve. Love is infinite. You cannot put a dollar value on the heart, and it takes no special talent to be a channel for love.

If you begin now, he says, it will be very, very soon that you will feel the universe about you warming to you, becoming a friendly place, becoming your home.

And a questioner asks how to be of service to those who are waking up and seeking. His answer is one of the wisest things in the early archive. Be very, very careful to listen with utmost clarity to what people ask of you, he says, and answer according to their needs. Familiarize yourself not only with the paths that are pleasant to you, but also with those paths which may not satisfy you, but which seem to be leading toward the one goal, which is the understanding of love. Rather than attempting to coerce anybody to follow the best path, encourage each person to follow any path. There is nothing more harmful than the person who is sure that there is only one path. Know that the Creator is on all paths towards spirit. Only attempt to discourage that seeking which separates man from his creation.

The healing was never complicated. Go wash in the river, seven times. The water was always right there.

Thank you for listening.

title: Become the Other
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: become the other.

February twenty-second, nineteen seventy-six. Hatonn begins with an image of all the spiritual paths at once. Consider it, he says, as a wheel, with an infinite number of spokes. Each spoke is an entirely different path, yet all are connected to the same center. All spokes protrude from the one center, as all paths have come from the Creator. Each person must choose the path he would wish to follow. And each person, in choosing that path, must realize that the path he has chosen shall lead to the ultimate point of interception with all other paths, the point of oneness.

We wish to prove nothing, he says. We wish only to be known. And to know us, and to know the Creator, you must transcend the illusion through the practice of meditation, and learn and know reality. Infinite reality. You shall never know all things within the intellect, yet all things, though they be infinite, are known to you within your spirit. Within your spirit, you have the knowledge of all times and all experiences. Within your spirit, lies reality. And within reality there is nothing but love.

Love to you, he says, is a concept which you have greatly misunderstood in your intellect. Yet within your spirit it is pure. It is holy and sacred and infinite. The more love you project into your present illusion, the more the illusion shall fade away, and reality appear. Throughout our experiences we have found only one stable aspect. That is love. It is everyone. It is around you. It is within you. It is infinite, and it is all things.

Then he gives them a scripture and a warning together. It is written in your holy works, he says, that the man who gives all that he has to the poor and gives his body to be burned, if he has not love, then he is worth nothing. Love in action, that which is called service, is indeed the highest of all manifestations of light within your peoples. Yet service without love is worth nothing. And the person that attempts to serve without the heart within clear and full of light showing forth as love, is defeating his own purposes.

Among your peoples, he says, love is already named by so many lesser emotions and states of mind, and none of these is love. If you can imagine the full force of the sun beating down upon you, and imagine that sun beating down equally, and totally, upon each entity, each blade of grass, moving each mote of air, and blessing the growth of each plant, this begins to tell you of the force of true love.

And now the practice. If you would love, he says, neither sympathize nor judge. Do not sympathize. Do not become lost in emotion, for love is not emotion, and emotional service is often a human service, and not the service of love. Rather, do the following. Take the entity whom you would love, and become that entity, not to sympathize nor to condemn, but to totally become that entity. Actually allow your consciousness to reside within that person. Do this carefully, quietly, completely. If you need to, imagine your body fitting the body of the other person. Make that complete an identification. And then, move this consciousness back within your body. Let the shoulders meet your shoulders, the head meet your head. Feel the union of two entities which are truly one. Love is one.

You know that is unity, he says, yet you sympathize, and condemn, and allow your human heart to rule that which should be free-flowing, always, without let or hindrance, regardless of how you as a person within the illusion feel about another person within the illusion. Know ye not that ye are ministers, each of you? Ministers of light, as are all people. Through your eyes shines the light of the Creator. If you wish to allow your inner feelings to shutter that light, then you will only show true love to a chosen few. And in doing so, you limit that love.

This is a hard lesson, but true, he says. And to the extent that you are able to do this, even partially, even very partially, you will light up a great, great deal of space within the finer spheres of the planetary vibration. You have heard of the search for one honest man, or a few righteous men, so that an entire community could be spared. This is due to the fact that one source of light can illumine a great deal of darkness.

You make a great deal of difference. It may not seem so on this plane, yet it is indeed so. The light which you are seeking to show cannot come from you, but through you. Only through you, pouring through you like the sun pours down into the tree, so that the tree may yield its fruit up, so that all may eat of its substance. You are, indeed, a tree, and you can be pruned. And if you allow the sunlight to develop you, all that pass may take the fruit from your boughs.

Not sympathy. Not judgment. Become the other, and come back. That is the whole exercise, and it is enough for a lifetime.

Thank you for listening.

title: The Person of Love
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: the person of love.

February twenty-ninth, nineteen seventy-six. A leap year day, an extra day the calendar tucks in, and Hatonn spends it talking about the cycles of high and low that everyone in the room knows too well. During the course of your daily lives, he says, you reach what we could call high and low spots. Sometimes you hit spots that seem to bring the truth of the Creator to your understanding, and other times you have spots that make you think there is no hope of understanding any of what is going on around you.

And you ask yourself what it is that links you with the truth. The things that sometimes emotionally affect you, as in art, where you feel as if someone has personally given you a key to higher understanding. You recognize this as beauty, he says, and these little conceptual awakenings are with you as you go through your daily lives. They are links, reminders of the eternal love and truth that can be within your full understanding if you desire it to be. The desire is your decision, and you will receive exactly what you desire.

This has a great deal to do with your thinking, he says. If you can control your thoughts, you control your destiny.

Then he addresses something the group had been discussing. Attachment and detachment. To be attached, and to be detached, is to be within the illusion, he says. You cannot be full or empty of concept without remaining within the illusion. To fill your consciousness with reality is far, far more desirable for spiritual advancement than to empty your consciousness of the illusion. Emptiness is not any special virtue. If you do not care about one thing or another within the illusion, yet still you are not full of the joy of the Creator, then you have nothing yet, no matter how detached you may be, or how attached you may be to higher things.

So seek, he says. Seek always to fill your consciousness with that which can only be heard in silence. The voice of the Creator. It is a still, small voice, as it has been written in your holy works. Yet it is thunder, and has the power to change and transform your entire experience. Your true nature, your truest nature, cannot be expressed. It can only be felt. And when you feel it, you will become a channel in your own way, to give that light and that love that is your true essence to all those with whom you come in contact.

And then, through another channel, the most practical and most intimate instruction of the night. When you seek in meditation, he says, do not content yourself with seeking something which you call love, or light. Seek the sweet voice of the person of love. If it be not Jesus in your mind, let it be who it will be, a perfect, loving, compassionate being who cares eternally and totally about you. Give your love, and open yourself to an exceptionally pure and personal feeling of love. Do not be contented until you feel the presence of this personification of love, until this presence is so close that if you turned around, you could see it next to you.

Love is real, he says, and within the physical you must begin to perceive it as real. Feel it, hear it, absorb it. In meditation, try to meet the Creator. Feel His breath on your cheek, His hand on your shoulder. Sense His loving, compassionate gaze. Know the fullness of total love. Do not be content with any less, for with any less, you will not be able to share this love with others.

And then the last line of the teaching, which I think is the point of the whole archive. Give it all away, he says, for love is not love until you have shared it. That which you take in and do not give away will rapidly become sour. Love is a flowing and ongoing stream. Let it flow through you.

Not emptiness. Fullness. Not a concept called love, but a person you can almost turn and see. And then, give it away before it sours.

Thank you for listening.

title: The Three Natures
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: the three natures.

March twenty-eighth, nineteen seventy-six. The beginning of the meeting was not recorded, and when the tape starts, the instrument is struggling. Hatonn is patient about it. He simply wants to talk about the thing nobody in the room can stop feeling. The friction between the individual and the society around him.

Those upon your planet, he says, as they enter through birth into this experience, immediately become exposed to the programming of the society in which they have chosen to exist. Many of those incarnated at this time have experienced, in other incarnations, social structures substantially different from this one, structures perhaps more conducive to spiritual growth. And this is the cause of the conflict they feel. When you woke up as a child in this world, immediately this world began to inform your mind of its version of reality. Each of you has knowledge within you, for you came into this world with your knowledge intact. You know that this world is not correct in its speaking to you. Yet you have been frustrated and unable to express this knowledge, because there are no words, and it seems sometimes there are no alternatives.

The very reason many have incarnated at this time, he says, is because this will be a difficult and laborious incarnation, giving them a great deal of challenge. Those who have incarnated into this density have chosen, not the easy way, but the way that leads to what they feel are greater rewards. For in hardship, lessons are learned much more quickly than in times of ease.

Then he lays out the map. You have three natures, he says. The first is of the earth. You are as the plants and the animals. One portion of you is of the earth and will remain with the earth. You fulfill your nature at this time, and this is a blessed and correct action, of instinct and of nature, as it should be in this world.

The second is your societal nature, that part of you which reacts with the creation of man as your animal nature reacts with the creation of the Father. You react with other men and with the creations of man, their ideas, their boundaries, their structures of all kinds. And here is his warning. That which is created in the mind of man, left to itself, will become more and more complicated, more and more conventionalized, until entanglements become so great that they strangle themselves. This is the inevitable end of mind without restraint.

Many have come to depend greatly upon the powers of the mind, and upon what other people say, and upon what is obviously the way things are. Yet how often they do not pull themselves through the complexity to the simplicity which lies beyond.

For your third nature is the spiritual. That which is infinite, invisible, eternal, omnipresent, omniscient, omnipotent. You are that which is. That which is, is you. The body and the mind, if properly tuned by care, may become the servants of the Creator Who dwells within your spirit. This is your proper nature, and it is to this end that you came into this rather trying, rather difficult, and rather laborious environment. If you can express what you understand in spirit within this environment, what a great light you will have to shed upon the world.

This is a chance to express love, he says, and so move on to further knowledge. It is as simple as that. Your body and your mind are either your masters or your servants. You cannot bully either your body or your mind. They are, properly, very strong. The only way they will become your servants is if you offer them a master which they recognize. The body and the mind recognize only that divine will which expresses through your spiritual nature. The master is within you. He has always been with you. He is within you and within me.

There are many shadows in life, he says, but when the sunrise has reached high enough for the sun to peep over the top of the hill, the shadows dissolve.

And he closes, the way an older brother would, with the only instruction that matters. Pay attention now, please, pay attention now. This is the time for paying attention, not to the things that bother your mind, although you must acknowledge and adjust to them, for the mind is useful, indispensable. Pay attention to the spiritual significance of this moment, and of each moment as it appears.

And one more caution, for those who want to move fast. Clarify within yourself those things which you truly desire, he says. For there are many things within this structure you could choose to desire, and some could lead you away from your chosen path. Meditate upon that which you desire, and if it is not proper, the desire itself shall dissipate.

Three natures. The animal, the social, the spiritual. Two of them are loud. The third is the one you came here to serve.

Thank you for listening.

title: The Day of Resurrection
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: the day of resurrection.

April eighteenth, nineteen seventy-six. It is Easter, and Hatonn knows it. As you observe this day in the name of the one known as Jesus, he says, be aware of his presence. For to observe within you this concept of Christ is to summon to yourself the consciousness which was represented by this being.

You must realize, he says, that the one known to you as Jesus was but a man, as you. He had nothing to offer other than his self and his knowledge, which he stressed many times to be that which you possess. Within you is the true Christ. Within you is the true Father of all. Within you is the consciousness which was displayed by this teacher. Within you is the vision which he foresaw, a vision of love and unity, a vision of a world ruled under no other laws than those of the Creator. A vision which is to be an experience. For that which you can envision, indeed you shall experience.

Hold true to your beliefs and desires, he says. Be assured within yourself of your guidance. And this shall be yours. All that you desire shall come to you. Therefore, be cautious and desire only those things which you know to be of love. Desire not that of the physical world, for if you fill your desires with love, then so shall you reap them. And whatever you need, it shall be provided.

And to realize this state of being, he says, once again, practice meditation. For within the silence of your meditation there shall be whispers of love from our Father, the Creator, guiding you upon the path of enlightenment which you so dearly desire.

Then he gives the Easter teaching its real meaning. The moment upon which any being consciously decides to seek the path of enlightenment may be referred to as a moment of resurrection. What the one known as Jesus performed upon this day was only a sign. He performed upon the physical plane a feat which was considered impossible, and the enlightenment obtained by those aware of his action was of great benefit. Yet it was but a representation upon the physical plane of what was taking place on the spiritual level. This was a moment in which many truly decided to begin to seek and follow that path.

Yet each and every day is a replay of that resurrection. For each and every day more and more of your peoples begin their search, in all honesty and with pure dedication, to seek Christ, to seek love, to seek fulfillment, to seek the Creator. Those who choose this shall indeed find that which they seek. Those within this room have arisen. Now it is time that you go forth, as did Christ, and allow those around you to see that you are indeed renewed. You need not speak of your resurrection. Allow it to shine. Allow it to be. Allow yourself to become the instrument of the consciousness to which we refer as Christ. Open your inner being so that you may receive and transmit clearly the love and light of Christ and of our Father, the Creator.

Earlier in the evening, through another channel, the group heard the teaching that every great teacher agrees on. Every great teacher who has ever visited your planet, the Buddha, Jesus Christ, and those now living, all these teach the same thing. Love everyone unconditionally, including yourself. Loving everyone unconditionally, including yourself, simply means that you never get bummed out. When you find yourself arguing with someone over this belief or that belief, stop arguing. When you find yourself making your will prevail over another human being, stop prevailing. Love speaks not to the ear. Love speaks to the heart. Remain constantly loving, consciously, at all times. It is your entire purpose.

And there is a practical word about the days ahead. You are going into a newer and higher vibration, he says, which intensifies all action generated by yourself. For those seeking love, it will be more easily attained. There are many about you in great need of something to believe in. Through your spiritual growth, you will find yourselves set upon by those wishing to know the truth. You need not go search them out. The positive charge attracts the negative. They will be drawn toward you. When you surround yourself in this love, heightened to a great degree, all that you may know is love.

You are the channels for the energies which are needed, he says. Attune yourself, and observe the resurrection of your planet. Resurrection is not a day on the calendar. It is the moment a person decides to seek, and every day the moment comes again.

Thank you for listening.

title: Love Casts Out Fear
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: love casts out fear.

May sixteenth, nineteen seventy-six. Hatonn begins by uniting the intentions of the group, and he notices, honestly, that it is sometimes more difficult to become one than at other times. It is sometimes a more distant goal to achieve an understanding of the true unity of yourself and your brothers. But truly, he says, you are now one. Each is filled with a love, not for the humanness of your brothers and sisters, but with a love for the perfect Creator in each brother and each sister. Though your physical bodies rest in seeming separation, the hands of your spirits have reached out and closed the circle.

A listener has wondered why, with craft appearing in the skies more often, the messages have become more philosophical and less about the appearances themselves. You, my friends, are already waking up, and our appearances in your skies have served their purpose with you. In the days to come, we will be appearing as much as we can, and people will be asking you questions, for they will know of your association with this type of group. So we are very interested in deepening your spiritual understanding of our mission. That is all that matters to us. You are our physical hands on this sphere. We can give you thoughts and advice, but it is to you, in the flesh, to whom people will turn.

Then the teaching. There is a method of dealing with the illusion, he says, by which you can use those happenings which are within the illusion in such a way that they become reality. The method is to remove fear from your attitude toward the illusion. Meditation is a great aid toward removing fear, for if you are confident from your meditation of the fact that all that exists is love, then whatever occurs on the outer planes, no matter whether it is pain, or death, or birth, or pleasure, you will be able to see it for what it is, that is, love. And you will accept pain and death, as well as pleasure and birth, so that the circumstance which is real upon the outer plane is absorbed into your being as it is, that is, as reality, and not as the illusion which your premature reactions will cause it to become.

Love casts out fear. This has been written in your holy works, and it is indeed true. If you fear any set of circumstances that may occur, you will not be able to see the reality of the love within these circumstances. It takes a good deal of resolute practice to refrain, finally, from fear of pain. But on the outer planes, this is what is. Pain and pleasure. Accept both within that stillness of being which is an awareness of love.

Through another channel he speaks of the storehouse within. There is within you the seed of life, he says. There is within you the babe of creation. There is within you the Christ of consciousness. There is within you the love and the light of the Creator. And to hold this within you, and to fail to utilize it, is to remain static upon your processes of growth. It is your choice, and it can be made by no other than yourself.

In order to be of service in the days to come, he says, it is only necessary that you see, that you see clearly, the function, the presence, the vibration of that love within your fellow man. See nothing but that love. No matter what may surround it, no matter what the person may do to you, you must recognize the love within that individual. You may choose not to be within that individual's presence, and this is your choice. But do so with the recognition of love. Pass not judgment upon your fellow man, for that which you sow, so shall ye reap.

Be cautious upon your journey, yet be not withholding of the love within you. Share it freely. Project it in all directions, and once again it shall flow unto you from all directions. To love freely is to be in a state where suppression does not exist. If you allow only the love and the light to flow from within you, there shall not be room for anything to come into you, other than that love and light.

Do not fathom within your consciousness that you are incapable of bringing about this flow, he says. If you fathom that thought, you will stop the flow. Acknowledge continually that what you seek, you shall receive.

And he closes the night the way he means it. My brothers and sisters, love one another. That is it. That is all we have to say. We have said it several times this evening. We say it once more. As you go forth into the world, you will very soon meet your next challenge. It will be a person whom it is difficult to conceive of on the outer planes as the Creator. You will fear him, and you will wish to put distance between yourself and him. And yet, you are one. If you can move the fear aside, the reality will seep into your being, and you will reflect unto him the joy of the spirit.

Thank you for listening.

title: The Point of Stillness
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: the point of stillness.

May thirtieth, nineteen seventy-six. Hatonn opens the evening with a meditation you can do right now, wherever you are sitting. Become aware, he says, of your symmetry as you sit. Your two legs, balanced. Each arm resting comfortably. Your eyes, the space between them, just balanced. That which you hear is being received symmetrically, stereophonically, by your ears. And you are in balance, each side in balance.

You are a creature, in the body, of this duality, your right and your left. As you rest in meditation, become quite reconciled to this two-sidedness of the physical. Begin to sense that point between your two sides, the point of balance, the point of stillness, the point that does not move. In between the two eyes is the point where your sight becomes one. Midway between your ears, you suddenly hear one whole sound.

You, my friends, are not creatures of duality. You simply reside in a physical body and in a physical universe which is of this nature. Therefore you are under the illusion that you are of this nature. And it is in meditation that you seek knowledge of your true self, which is free from duality.

Many of your troubles in the physical arise, he says, from the fact that you have allowed that center of stillness to be moved by outward events, so that you seem unable to regain that balance. Now, find the balance of your body, and then release that connection. Do not become so comfortable within your body that you forget you are actually a stranger to this environment. Your essential being is unified. You not only know what this unity within yourself is, you are this unity. Coming into the knowledge of it is simply a matter of remaining still long enough to begin to know the true self. It is not a knowledge that must be pulled from far away. You are that knowing.

Through another channel he speaks of what knowledge really is. Knowledge, he says, is much more than the possession of the intellect. Knowledge in its true essence is a state of being, a form of existence. It is the spiritual manifestation of the divine intellect of the Creator. Your spiritual existence is everlasting and unlimited, and from within the spiritual intellect there is instantaneous knowledge, all knowledge of the universe, all knowledge of the Creator.

Seek not identification with the world in which you exist, he says. Seek to identify with the universe which you are and which you have experienced and which you shall remain experiencing. Seek to be one, and to be aware of it. Know that it is your birthright to tap the knowledge of the universe.
